notes.title: BUG FIX: ENJOY A FASTER CHEMISTRIS
notes.notes:
After a whole quarter, the reaction algorithm of CHEMISTRIS now runs faster. We have found and solved a deep-hidden bug on duplication deletion of reaction. The delivery delay is majorly caused by the physical crash of developing computer :(

Just enjoy a faster CHEMISTRIS :)
